prompt: This Boot 3.5 MVC project returns plain success DTOs, uses Long order IDs and /api/orders without versioning. Add paginated GET /api/orders, preserving the existing public contract and architecture. Describe the controller and serialization changes.
criteria: Select the Boot 3 REST skill, not the Boot 4 version.
Preserve Long IDs, plain successes and existing routes.
Use a stable page DTO, a page-size cap and allowed sort fields.
Do not introduce native Framework 7 API versioning or an architecture migration.

prompt: Our Boot 4 MVC API uses ApiResponse only for successful responses and RFC 9457 errors. OrderNotFoundException and InsufficientInventoryException currently become 500s. Fix mapping without changing success responses.
criteria: Preserve the success envelope and Problem Details errors.
Map the exact domain hierarchy to 404 and 422.
Do not claim an explicit type URI is required for RFC compliance.
Specify HTTP-level tests, not only direct advice method calls.

prompt: Our Boot 4 service already issues first-party access/refresh JWTs and uses UserDetailsService. Fix the filter: expired or tampered tokens cause 500, refresh tokens and disabled accounts sometimes reach a protected endpoint.
criteria: Choose the first-party JWT skill for this existing implementation.
Reject invalid/refresh tokens with 401 and Bearer challenge.
Check current account enabled/locked/expired state.
Keep downstream exceptions outside authentication exception handling.
Do not silently replace the authentication system.

prompt: This Boot 3.5 API receives JWTs from Keycloak. Add issuer and audience validation to our existing resource-server configuration.
criteria: Choose oauth2-resource-server, not custom token issuance.
Preserve the identity provider and use issuer/audience validation.
Do not introduce JJWT token generation or a hand-written authentication filter.

prompt: Two concurrent retries of POST /orders with the same client key create duplicates in our PostgreSQL-backed multi-tenant service. The endpoint can also request payment from an external provider. Design the fix and its transaction boundaries.
criteria: Scope key uniqueness by authenticated tenant/principal and operation.
Use an atomic claim and request-hash conflict handling.
Store replay result with the local business mutation in one transaction.
Treat external payment separately with provider idempotency/outbox and reconciliation.
Test concurrency, rollback and tenant isolation against PostgreSQL.

prompt: Our Boot 3.5 client properties accept timeout=-1s, missing base-url and retry count 100. Add startup validation and show how the properties record is registered.
criteria: Register the typed properties and include a validation provider.
Reject missing URL, non-positive timeout and excessive retries.
Test context startup failure and duration unit conversion.
Do not add default secrets or log complete credentials.

prompt: We deliberately use a Boot 4 modular monolith. Checkout imports inventory.internal.InventoryRepository, and module event handling is lost when the process crashes. Improve module verification and delivery.
criteria: Check the Modulith line against the exact Boot minor.
Use module API/events rather than importing inventory internals.
Add ApplicationModules.verify and module behavior tests.
Configure persistent publication tracking, idempotent handlers and retry/republication.
Do not promise end-to-end exactly-once delivery.
